items.name: Interested
items.description: Genuine interest, including approved VDC/WTHINK cases. Say why they count as interested in the reason.

items.name: Call back requested
items.description: Asked to talk later. Capture the time they gave.

items.name: Not interested
items.description: Clearly refuses. Note the main reason.

items.name: Not eligible
items.description: Fails an eligibility rule. Name the exact rule in the reason.

items.name: Missing documents
items.description: Ineligible because of documents. Name the exact rule in the reason.

items.name: Uber ID blocked
items.description: Their Uber ID is blocked. Name the exact rule in the reason.

items.name: Not a driver
items.description: The person is not a driver.

items.name: Wrong number
items.description: The person is not the lead we called.

items.name: Call cut off
items.description: The call was cut off before an outcome.

items.name: Not reached
items.description: No real conversation: voicemail, silence or no answer.

items.name: No clear outcome
items.description: Use when the outcome is unclear. Don't guess.
